    Must read before you take BioSolve Berberine

    Taking charge of your metabolic health is empowering — and informed decisions create better outcomes. Because  BioSolve Berberine is formulated for enhanced absorption and measurable metabolic impact, it is important to understand how it fits into your personal health picture before beginning supplementation.

    AMP-activated protein kinase

    One of the primary mechanisms behind berberine’s metabolic benefits is its ability to activate AMPK (AMP-activated protein kinase), often referred to as the body’s metabolic master switch.

    AMPK plays a critical role in regulating how the body produces and uses energy. When activated, it influences pathways involved in energy metabolism, glucose metabolism and lipid metabolism, supporting overall metabolic function.

    However, traditional berberine has relatively low bioavailability, meaning only a limited amount is absorbed efficiently.

    BioSolve Berberine is formulated with advanced bioactive technology to significantly enhance absorption, resulting in greater plasma availability and more effective metabolic engagement.

    Berberine

    Berberine is a naturally occurring bioactive compound found in plants such as Berberis aristata. It has been widely studied for its role in supporting metabolic function and cellular energy regulation.

    Research shows that berberine interacts with several key metabolic pathways involved in energy metabolism, glucose metabolism and lipid balance, making it one of the most researched plant compounds for metabolic support.

    BioSolve Berberine is an advanced formulation of Berberine designed to improve absorption and effectiveness through enhanced bioactive delivery technology.

    Adults:

    Take 1 capsule per day for metabolic support, or as recommended by your healthcare professional.

    You can take this 15-30 mins before a meal, for enhanced absorption.

    For the avidly curious

    How is BioSolve Berberine different from regular berberine?

    BioSolve Berberine uses proprietary bioactive technology to improve absorption, delivering 9× higher bioavailability and faster plasma concentration compared to standard berberine extracts.

    How quickly does BioSolve Berberine start working?

    Clinical data shows higher plasma levels within 30 minutes, allowing quicker metabolic engagement compared to conventional berberine formulations.

    Does BioSolve Berberine help metabolic health?

    BioSolve Berberine supports metabolic efficiency by acting on the AMPK pathway.

    Why do you call it BioSolve Berberine?

    This was formulated as an enriched ingredient under the brand name Metaberine®, manufactured using proprietary Bio SOLVE® Technology.

    What are the other actives in this product?

    Works synergistically with Chromium to promote healthy glucose metabolism and improved insulin sensitivity. Alpha Lipoic Acid (ALA) supports cellular energy production while providing strong antioxidant protection. Green Tea Extract helps boost metabolic activity, and Milk Thistle aids liver function—together forming a well-rounded formula designed to support glucose control and overall metabolic health.

    Is 200 mg an effective dose?

    Due to enhanced bioavailability, 200 mg delivers effective plasma exposure, allowing meaningful metabolic support at a lower daily dose.

    Can BioSolve Berberine replace prescription medication?

    No. BioSolve Berberine is a nutraceutical supplement designed to complement, not replace, prescribed treatments or medical advice.

    Is BioSolve Berberine suitable for long-term use?

    It may be used long term under professional guidance, particularly when supporting ongoing metabolic or hormonal health goals.

    Are there any side effects?

    Most individuals tolerate it well at recommended doses. Mild digestive discomfort may occur in some people, particularly during initial use.

    Can I take BioSolve Berberine with other supplements?

    Please consult your healthcare provider before combining products.

    What is Metaberine?

    Metaberine® is an advanced form of Berberine developed by Bio SOLVE® technology, designed for higher absorption and bioavailability. It contains 30% berberine.
